council: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
current_evidence: The council's Checklists page (lbbd.gov.uk/planning-building-control-and-local-land-charges/planning/checklists) links this PDF as "Full Planning Applications Checklist - February 2026", and the document itself says "Checklist reviewed: February 2026"; the page also links separate per-type checklists (householder 'Last updated: 27th July 2026', adverts, LDCs, NMA, prior approval larger home extension).

issues.detail: Grokbot mixed the superseded August 2022 checklists (2022-08/Application-for-Planning-Permission-validation-checklist_0.pdf and 2022-08/Planning-application-Householder-validation-checklist_0.pdf) with the current 2026 documents. About 13 app_type rows take their triggers from the old 2022 full-planning checklist (Affordable Housing, Arboricultural, Biodiversity Checklist, CEMP, Energy, Flood Risk, Foul Sewage, Health Impact Assessment, Planning Obligations, SCI, Tall buildings, Travel Plan, LBC Photographs), and the old triggers differ from the February 2026 list. Examples: Energy says 'Required for all major developments' but the 2026 list requires an Energy and Sustainability Statement for all development. HIA says 'May be required to support a major residential development' but 2026 also covers new hot food takeaways, betting shops, casinos, amusement arcades and payday loan shops. Affordable Housing says '10 or more residential units' but 2026 also catches schemes under 10 with capacity for 10+, over 1,000 sqm of residential floorspace, or linked sites. SCI says 'May be required for large scale developments' but 2026 says major development. 'Biodiversity Checklist' quotes a Phase 1 Habitat Survey rule, but 2026 has an Ecological Assessment for all major development and sites in or next to a SINC.
issues.evidence: Checklists page links only 2026-dated files; Feb 2026 checklist: Energy and Sustainability Statement 'All development'; HIA includes hot food takeaways, betting shops etc.

issues.detail: Sustainable Drainage Strategy (SuDS) and Proforma is not captured anywhere. There is no drainage row for Full planning. Trigger: major development, and minor development that affects surface water run-off or is in a critical drainage area.
issues.evidence: Feb 2026 Local Information Requirements: 'Sustainable Drainage Strategy (SuDS) and Proforma' - major development; minor development affecting surface water run-off / critical drainage area

issues.detail: Several 2026 sustainability requirements are missing. Whole Life Carbon Assessment (all development). Circular Economy Statement (all development). Overheating Assessment (major development). Urban Greening Factor (major development). The Energy and Sustainability Statement trigger is also wrong: it now applies to all development, combined for minor and expanded for major, not just major.
issues.evidence: Feb 2026 checklist: 'Whole Life Carbon Assessment' all development; 'Circular Economy Statement' all development; 'Overheating Assessment' major; 'Urban Greening Factor' major

issues.detail: Construction and servicing requirements are missing as separate items. Construction Logistics Plan (Outline): major development with significant construction vehicle movements, and possibly minor development in sensitive locations. It appears only as stray text inside the Crime Impact Statement trigger. Site Waste Management Plan (construction waste): major development. Delivery and Servicing Plan: major or minor development with regular commercial deliveries, or in sensitive locations including residential and mixed-use.
issues.evidence: Feb 2026 checklist items 'Construction Logistics Plan (Outline)', 'Site Waste Management Plan (Construction Waste)', 'Delivery and Servicing Plan'; checklists page also links a 'CLP Proforma'

issues.detail: Other 2026 local requirements are not captured: Access Statement (new residential, mixed-use, or residential change of use or conversion); Basement Impact Assessment (certain new or extended basements); Bat Survey (development likely to affect bat roosts or foraging and commuting habitat); Green Belt / Grey Belt Assessment (Green Belt development with external alterations); Materials (indicative details for all development, full details for major development and heritage settings); Odour Assessment (major development, or sensitive uses near an odour source); Vibration Study (near a vibration source or likely to cause vibration); Operational Management Plan (supported housing and care homes, community facilities, places of worship, high-occupancy uses); Wind and Microclimate Study (large-scale development, tall buildings, exposed or sensitive sites). Grokbot only has an old 2022 'tall building' fragment for the wind study.
issues.evidence: Feb 2026 checklist Local Information Requirements table (Access Statement, Basement Impact Assessment, Bat Survey, Green Belt / Grey Belt Assessment, Materials, Odour Assessment, Vibration Study, Operational Management Plan, Wind and Microclimate Study)

issues.detail: LBBD publishes separate 2026-07 validation checklists for Advertisement consent, LDC (existing), LDC (proposed), Non-material amendment and Prior approval larger home extension. Grokbot did not read them and recorded '(none) national requirements only' for Advertisement consent, Lawful development cert and Non-material amendment. Those '(none)' entries are unsupported.
issues.evidence: Checklists page: 'Application for consent to display an advertisement(s) checklist', 'Application for a lawful development certificate ... checklist', 'Application for a non-material amendment ...' (all 2026-07 PDFs)

issues.detail: Economic Statement is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. It comes from the Full Planning checklist, where 'change of use' means a planning application for change of use creating over 5,000 sqm of employment floorspace. It is not a prior approval requirement.
issues.evidence: Feb 2026 Full Planning checklist: 'Economic Statement - New employment related development (including change of use) where the floorspace created would be over 5,000 square metres'

issues.detail: Crime Impact Statement is placed under 'Discharge of conditions'. This happened because the trigger excerpt runs into Construction Logistics Plan text that mentions the 'discharge of conditions stage'. The source makes the Crime Impact Statement a Full planning requirement for major development, particularly large residential.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpt: '...Second, a Detailed CLP is submitted ... at the post-granted discharge of conditions stage'

issues.detail: Tree Survey / Arboricultural Assessment is placed under 'Works to trees'. The source is the Full planning checklist, where it is needed for development that affects TPO trees, trees in a Conservation Area, or nearby trees. It is not a requirement for a TPO or conservation area tree works application.
issues.evidence: Feb 2026 Full Planning checklist: 'Tree Survey / Arboricultural Assessment - Any development that impacts a tree that is subject to a Tree Preservation Order'

issues.detail: Heritage Statement and Photographs/Photomontages are placed under 'Listed building consent', but both come from the full-planning checklists. LBBD's checklists page has no LBC checklist, so this placement is inferred. Also, the many 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning' notes are misleading. The source document is explicitly titled 'Full Planning Application Validation Checklist', so Full planning is correct for those rows, and Grokbot should not have flagged them as inferred.
issues.evidence: Document title 'Full Planning Application Validation Checklist'; Photographs row sourced from 2022-08 Application-for-Planning-Permission checklist

issues.detail: Several rows quote the trigger of a different requirement. 'Electric vehicle charging details' quotes the Parking Stress Survey trigger; EV charging is not a separate 2026 item. 'Retail / Town Centre Impact' quotes EIA screening text; the actual trigger is over 2,500 sqm of retail, leisure or office outside town centres not in line with an up-to-date Local Plan. 'Telecommunications' quotes the Transport Assessment trigger; the actual trigger is mast and antenna development by mobile operators. 'Marketing / vacancy evidence' is actually the Community Facility Need Statement (creation or loss of community facilities, C2, F1 and F2). 'CIL Additional Information' under Full planning quotes the self-build Form 7 text; CIL Form 1 is required for every application.
issues.evidence: Feb 2026 checklist: 'Evidence for Town Centre Uses' >2,500 sqm; 'Telecommunications Supplementary Information' mast/antenna; 'CIL Form 1 (Additional Information)' every application

issues.detail: Many Full planning triggers are garbled column-merges or fragments with no actual condition. Air Quality: '(July The Air Quality Assessment must be prepared...)'. The actual trigger is all major development, some minor development in Air Quality Focus Areas, or where impacts are likely. Contaminated Land: 'Ancient Monuments) Land Contamination Assessment Landscaping Plan / Strategy'; actual is all brownfield development and areas of natural risk. Landscaping: 'Contamination Assessment Landscaping Plan / Strategy'; actual is major development and minor residential. Noise: 'electricity The noise impact assessment must be prepared...'; actual covers plant or extraction, noisy uses, noise-sensitive uses in noisy areas, and traffic increases over 5% of AADT. Archaeology: 'Where necessary, a WSI'; actual is groundworks on sites of archaeological significance or in an Archaeological Priority Area. Design and Access Statement has no trigger; actual is major development, or in or affecting a CA or listed building. Environmental Statement, Fire Statement, Viability and Tall buildings triggers are also scrambled or cut off.
issues.evidence: Grokbot excerpts quoted above vs Feb 2026 'Local Information Requirements' table

issues.detail: The Householder 'Highways / access details (visibility splays)' row quotes the site-plan content list (items c-g: access arrangements, rights of way, trees, hard surfacing, boundaries). It is not a highways requirement. The householder checklist's actual local item, 'Parking and access arrangements' (where the proposal affects parking or access on the site or in the surrounding area), is not captured. The Householder 'Floor plans / Elevations' row quotes only the elevations wording.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist (Last updated 27th July 2026): local requirement 'Parking and access arrangements' where proposal affects parking or access

issues.detail: The council tab holds only 6 items, and none is a validation requirement. They are: pre-application and 'HOW TO SUBMIT' boilerplate; 'Do not send hard copies as we are a paperless office' (from the superseded 2022 checklist); web-page navigation text ('Community Infrastructure Levy (CIL) Validation Checklist | ... Download .pdf 196.84 KB Contents ...'); the viability Excel-format note; and the fragment 'include a scale bar and north arrow'. None of the roughly 56 local requirements in the February 2026 list appears in the tab.

Several rows repeat the same trigger text. 'Telecommunications' and 'Transport Assessment' both quote the Transport Assessment trigger. 'Contaminated Land' and 'Landscaping' both quote the same column-header fragment. 'Self-build' and 'CIL' both quote the CIL Form 7 sentence.

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Full Planning checklist (reviewed February 2026, linked from the LBBD Checklists page). However, many rows come from superseded 2022 checklists, many triggers are garbled or belong to other items, and about 20 current local requirements are missing, including SuDS, Whole Life Carbon, Circular Economy, Construction Logistics Plan and Urban Greening Factor. Several rows are also placed under the wrong application type (prior approval, discharge of conditions, works to trees), and the per-type checklists for adverts, LDCs and NMAs were not read.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
